novel_features.name: Local FTS5 search across all record types
novel_features.description: Full-text search across every synced object's records in one command. Returns typed hits across company, person, opportunity, and every mirrored Salesforce object.

novel_features.name: Read-only SQL over the local mirror
novel_features.description: Run read-only SQL queries with joins across per-object record tables. Cross Unify standard objects with Salesforce-mirrored ones in a single query.

novel_features.name: Coverage report between two object tables
novel_features.description: Set-difference report between two record tables on a shared key with optional bucketing by attribute and matched-but-stale rows.

novel_features.name: Score-divergence audit
novel_features.description: Flag records where two numeric attributes diverge beyond a threshold. Powers scoring sanity checks across Unify-internal and Salesforce-mirrored score fields.

novel_features.name: Schema snapshot + diff
novel_features.description: Snapshot objects, attributes, and attribute options; diff two snapshots to find adds, removes, and type changes.

novel_features.name: Batch domain vetting
novel_features.description: Read a CSV column of match values, run find-unique in parallel for each, and enrich each row with exists/has_opportunity/owner/last_activity_at.

novel_features.name: CSV upsert plan preview
novel_features.description: Predict what an upsert from CSV will do (create / update / no-op counts per row) by combining the local mirror with find-unique fallbacks.

novel_features.name: Local reference trace
novel_features.description: Walk reference attributes (opportunities, people, owner) from a starting record without N+1 API calls.

novel_features.name: Watchlist-driven sync
novel_features.description: Persist match-keys for records you care about; sync refreshes them via parallel find-unique on every run.
